operations.source: Header of the revised format, so the importer records each source's reference with its fatigue limits

Both sources name the alloy 7075-T6 (Pedranz 2025: 27 times, T6511 once; Benedetti 2021: 12 times); T6511 is the T6 temper of extrusions stress-relieved by stretching. The name now matches the material ID, so the importer's source-identity check passes
